Build.description: The assembly stated by the source; no default is inferred.

CodingChange.description: HGVS 21.1 coding edit syntax without a reference. The parser additionally requires increasing range endpoints, different substitution bases and insertion adjacency where literal positions establish it. It does not check transcript sequence or exon boundaries.

GeneSymbol.description: Source spelling of a gene symbol, with ASCII case-insensitive identity.

MyVariantQuery.description: Explicit MyVariant query text. The schema limits Unicode character count; the parser additionally limits UTF-8 byte count to the same maximum.

Text.description: Bounded nonempty text with surrounding Unicode whitespace removed.

VariantRegion.description: Primary-chromosome region. The parser additionally requires the end to be at least the start.

VariantSearchField.description: Source-proven component fields supported by the presence filter.

VariantSearchSource.description: The source-native query language exposed by variant search.

description: Discover source candidates using one declared selector, without interpreting free text.

build.description: Optional caller assembly sent to MyVariant; regions require it explicitly.

coding.description: Coding HGVS change searched literally in ClinVar with --gene, without choosing a transcript.

condition.description: Literal MyVariant clinvar.rcv.conditions.name phrase; source text is not a local diagnosis. Requires a declared protein or region selector.

gene.description: Checked gene symbol for the dbNSFP substitution or ClinVar coding/synonymous selector.

has.description: Require the selected component's identifier field. Only source-proven mappings are offered.

limit.description: Native candidates per page, default 10, maximum 50; all candidates remain candidates.

offset.description: Native offset within this command's bounded result window; larger native totals remain visible.

protein.description: Explicit substitution or synonymous change using checked amino-acid codes.

query.description: Raw MyVariant query, passed and echoed unchanged when component policy allows; requires --source myvariant. With disabled components use declared selectors instead.

region.description: Exact one-based inclusive MyVariant region, such as chr7:55259500-55259600; requires --build.

review_status.description: Literal MyVariant clinvar.rcv.review_status phrase; no star conversion. Requires a declared protein or region selector.

source.description: Explicit source language; required for a raw query.

title: VariantSearch
